response.text: {"title":"Residual alone does not fix the solution","body":"The PDE only constrains how y changes locally, so many different functions satisfy it equally well. For example, adding any solution of the homogeneous equation y_t = y_xx to the true y leaves the residual unchanged. The initial and boundary conditions are what select the unique solution. With only lossPDE, the network drives the loss to 0.00034 on the wrong function, so rel_l2 stays near 0.97.","explanation_index":1,"citation_id":"raissi2019"}
